digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions mirror CI for main branch
propositions: Cancelled GitHub Actions runs on main render as red X on healthy commits because concurrency group cancels previous runs when new commits push to main
Six workflows currently trigger on push to main with cancellation semantics, causing the mirror to report false failures when commits land close together
Mirror main CI must switch from push-triggered per-commit validation to scheduled 6-hourly health checks to eliminate cancellations by construction
Last-known-green SHA and git bisect recipe must be published in workflow output to enable efficient triage of actual failures spanning multiple commits
Pre-merge Gerrit Verified gate and per-patchset CI are unaffected; only the post-merge safety net timing changes from per-push to periodic scheduling
